agent_prompt:
Set up CheckIn for me. Install its skill with
curl -fsSL {base}/install.sh | sh
(if you aren't Claude Code, add: -s -- --dir YOUR_SKILLS_FOLDER). Then read the skill's SKILL.md and sign me in with
python3 ~/.claude/skills/checkin/scripts/checkin.py login
(that folder, or wherever you installed it). Show me the link and the code it prints, wait while I approve with
login --wait, then run status and tell me today's plan. Never ask me for a password.
